name: China Suntien Green Energy Corporation Limited
summary: China Suntien Green Energy Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in new energy and natural gas businesses in Mainland China. The company is involved in the wind farm construction and operation management; sale of electricity; purchasing gas from upstream companies; construction and operation management of long-distance pipelines; and provision of LNG terminal services. It also operates a total wind power holding projects under construction had a total capacity of 964.4 MW; 5 CNG mother stations, 3 CNG daughter stations, 3 LNG refueling stations, and 1 L-CNG combined station; and controlled photovoltaic (PV) capacity was 369.19 MW, cumulative managed PV capacity was 539…
